"I-Rime Wordlist idinga futhi i-UniDict: kunye nokuhlinzeka nge-Offline Dictionary, thika \"Chinese and Cantonese characters (UniDict)\" bese uyayiyeka iqedele ukulanda kuqala. Ngaphandle kwayo, uhlu olufunda izinhlamvu alukhiqizi ukufundwa.
Thika uhlu i-Rime Wordlist okufanele ilufunde, bese uchofoza u-Save ukuze ululande. Uhlu olulufakile lususwa lapho uluthika kabusha.
Uhlu lwakho luyithebula lakho lamagama nokufundwa kwawo, i-.dict.yaml enemigqa efana nale: 字 ham 典 din2 Inxuba yokuqala igama, yesibili ukufundwa kwalo; izinkhumu ezengeziwe nemigqa engenalo ithebhu ziyashiywa."
Ayikho uhlu lwamagama lwe-Rime olukhethiwe olulimi olungenhla. Thinta leli gama ukuze ukhethe olulodwa, noma ukhethe ulimi olunohlu
Ifayela loku- .dict.yaml, noma i-zip elinye, enemigqa efana ne- 字 ham kanye ne- 典 din2. Uhlu lutholakala lapho ukukhetha khona bese uchofoza u-Save, futhi ilayisense yalo iwena ozoyihlola

Izinyathelo: 1. Ngena ku-music.apple.com njengomeluleko 2. Vula i-DevTools → Application → Cookies → music.apple.com 3. Kopisha inani le-\"media-user-token\""

"Namathisela i-cookie ye-sp_dc evela ku-Spotify.
Izinyathelo: 1. Ngena ku-open.spotify.com 2. Vula i-DevTools → Application → Cookies → open.spotify.com 3. Kopisha inani le-\"sp_dc\""

"Namathisela i-arl cookie evela ku-Deezer.
Izinyathelo: 1. Ngena ku-deezer.com 2. Vula i-DevTools → Application → Cookies → deezer.com 3. Kopisha inani le-\"arl\""

"Namathisela i-cookies yakho ye-YouTube ukuze ufune ama-captions ne-timetext ku-YouTube.
Izinyathelo: 1. Vula i-youtube.com ku-browser bese ungena 2. Vula i-DevTools (F12) → Application → Cookies → youtube.com 3. Kopisha u-cookie string ophelele (ama-key=value pairs ahlukaniswe ama-semicolons)
I-cookies ezidingekayo: SID, HSID, SSID, SAPISID, __Secure-3PAPISID, __Secure-1PAPISID, LOGIN_INFO"

"Amazwi ingoma afana nangesihloko nomculi, imininingwane engajwayelekile ingase ingatholi lutho noma ithole inguqulo engalungile. Sebenzisa i-refresh ukuze ushintshe izinguqulo. Abahlinzeki abamakiwe ngo-* badinga i-token. Bonke abahlinzeki abavunyelwe abicelwa ngaso sonke isikhathi ngokulandelana kwakho, kodwa baphendula ngokwemikhawulo yabo yesivinyelo.
Amazwi ingoma avela ezinkundleni zangaphandle ezingahlobene ne-Morphe, ezingaxhaswa, noma ezingaqashwa yi-Morphe. Ngasinye sisetshenziswa njengoba sinjalo: amazwi, ukutholakala kwawo, kanye nelayisense yawo kusala nalezo zinkundla kanye nabanikazi belayisense zabo, futhi ukusebenzisa lawa kungaba ngaphansi kwemigomo yawo yezidingo. Okufika enkundleni evunyelwe wukusesha okukicelile kuphela - isihloko, umculi, futhi lapho inkundla ikudinga khona, i-video ID. I-AI endpoint ekhethiwe kanye ne-QuickLRC transcription zisebenza kuphela ngemuva kokuba uzilungiselele, futhi zithole umbhalo wamazwi engoma noma i-video URL yomculo."
Vula kuphela abahlinzeki obasebenzisayo, noma ushiye okujwayelekile - izicelo eziqhubekayo zingaba nzima emawebhasayithi amancane amazwi omphakathi
